frontier.hypothesis: F8 (strengthened) — motion_Close is an escalation candidate: all three residual mechanisms now carry a backend-level disproof, and the whole-TU axis that F10 held open is closed.
frontier.mechanism: H1 (16-byte outgoing-arg area — s7: compile-time constant applied by MAX on every call-expansion path; the only cfoas-free site, __builtin_apply, emits a frame pointer + 72-byte frame + 34 insns), F5 (ascending first-free hard-reg scan, no MIPS REG_ALLOC_ORDER, so $v0 not $t0 — s5b), F7a (mips.c:4680 emits GP saves high-to-low unconditionally and an incoming-arg WAR anti-dependence does not reorder them — s8, upgrading s6's signature-conditional kill), F7b (empty beqz delay slot needs a block with no eligible single insn while the target's holds four — s6). The s7 residual table accounts for 13/13 points with nothing left over. The canonical-asm endgame gate is a MEASURED FAILED gate (scan_hand_coded tier LOW 0/8 for this function and its sibling, s6) and no coercion/spelling family has an in-hand SOTN-master precedent.
frontier.next_probe: Do NOT self-dispose — exhaustion is the driver's call and this session's modality was rederive, not escalation. When the driver routes this to `escalation`, the packet is fully determined and both endgame-lock gates FAIL, so under the owner's 2026-07-27 standing auto-ruling the terminal entry is REFUSED / OWNER-ACCEPTED INCOMPLETE, citing as load-bearing artifacts the s7 backend disproof of H1, the s7 residual table, and the s8 mips.c:4680 disproof of F7a.

frontier.hypothesis: F11 (new, the successor to F10) — the residual is invariant under everything ABOVE the function body, so the only untried surface left is the DECLARATION of the three globals the function touches.
frontier.mechanism: s8 measured signature, inlining, TU order and helper parameterisation all inert or worse, and s1-s7 measured the body exhaustively. What no session has varied is how D_800A2668 / D_8008D070 / D_00000000 are DECLARED (currently `extern s32`, `extern void (*)(void)`, `extern s32` at src/ings2.c:613-615). A declaration change is the only remaining input to cc1 that is neither a body respelling nor a shape change — e.g. array types (`extern void (*D_8008D070[])(void);`), a struct wrapping the pair so one address materialisation serves both, or an `extern char` for the linker-provided count symbol. This cannot touch H1 (the arg area is signature-independent) and is very unlikely to touch F5 (the scan order is allocation-order-independent), so the honest expected outcome is a third kill — but it is cheap and it is the last structural input nobody has varied.
frontier.next_probe: Sweep declaration forms for the three globals with the floor-13 body held fixed, measuring sandbox score AND the allocno table. IMPORTANT: do this by editing the real `extern` lines, never with an `asm("Sym")` alias rename — that is a forbidden family (inline-asm-injection §alias renames) and an aliased variant must not even be measured. If two address materialisations can legitimately collapse to one, the instruction count changes and the whole residual table must be re-derived rather than reused.

frontier.hypothesis: F4b (carried forward, purely cosmetic, narrowed by this session) — reach floor 13 with a do-while(0) wrap depth below 3.
frontier.mechanism: The floor-13 form's only construct is a THREE-level do{}while(0) wrap around p's initialiser, winning p $s0 by loop-depth reference weighting (p 10 weighted refs / live_length 8 = 37500 vs count's 34285). s5b measured depths 1 and 2 insufficient and depths 4-6 worthless on the direct body; s8 measured the same ladder, value for value, on both inlined chassis, so the device is minimal for this function's reference structure and not merely for this body's spelling.
frontier.next_probe: Only worth time if a session is preparing a submission, which cannot happen while H1 stands. The one untried direction is lengthening count's live range without adding a count reference — an intervening real computation the target also performs — and the target performs none, so this is close to dead. Success criterion is score 13 at wrap depth < 3, not a lower score.
